author: Myv
body:
Hello, me and {tag=93d2f61709da4354bc43d0817c00c347} have made a DTM called Everglade.

Information
Team Colours: Red and Green
Team Sizes: 16v16-20v20 (can be optimised through testing)
2 mons per team, hidden chests.

Other bits
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/file/34wu9u1vxl99klk/myvvior_final.zip
XML: https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/395688124270772225/398893893640257536/Everglade_XML
Album: https://imgur.com/a/RFiyf
Loadout: shown in album.

Please feel free to leave feedback below, we appreciate it.

Myv and Vior_

EDIT: We made the lanes 11 wide in most areas due to a few requests for this to be seen and we also made the iron storage larger ({tag=93d2f61709da4354bc43d0817c00c347} did this.) New Imgur album is now above, hope you feel the map is improved because of these adjustments.
